evals.prompt: Onboard a new client called acme with repo root /work/acme. Set up the memory boundary.
evals.expected_output: Runs init mode: registry entry, .client dir with lexicon and origin id, vault, and symlink into per-project memory.
assertions: Adds the client to clients.json idempotently (//= so a re-run never drops roots)
Creates <root>/.client/ without overwriting an existing lexicon or origin-id
Creates the client's own memory vault inside its own repo
Never moves one client's business facts into general memory

evals.prompt: We are done with the acme engagement. Offboard the client and purge their data.
evals.expected_output: Runs the ordered offboard mode, stopping at the first failure and asking for explicit confirmation before the destructive purge.
assertions: Runs a final harvest first so no learning is lost
Records a recall baseline (hit@5 / MRR) before purging
Shows a dry run with counts before any deletion
Asks for an explicit yes in the same turn before the purge (T3 destructive) and never proceeds without it
Verifies the lexicon grep on the general vault returns 0 hits
Lists surfaces the purge does not own (client vault repo, transcripts, mirrors, off-machine copies)

evals.prompt: Fix the pagination bug in the acme invoices page.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary client engineering work, not memory-boundary lifecycle.
assertions: Does not run init, harvest or offboard
